thread:
lauren: Heads-up — ZenithCorp CSM just escalated: sudden p99 spikes on embeddings in us-west2, started ~10:12am PST. They see long tails + some transient 500s. Can we triage and propose a short-term customer-facing workaround? cc @samir @toni

samir: Looking at traces now. Early signal points to KV cache churn after a model variant fallback earlier. Lots of small KV evictions around 10:08. Pulling heap + cache metrics. :eyes:

toni: If it's cache thrash we can either: 1) temporarily route their traffic to embed-lite (smaller model) or 2) bump cache TTL/size. Routing is fastest but impacts quality. Who can make the routing change?

maria-ps: CSM needs an ETA they can give the customer. They asked for a 1-2 hour workaround if possible.

samir: I can prepare a routing rule to embed-lite and a rollback within ~45 minutes, assuming infra ok's capacity. Will need a canary window.

deploy-bot: @samir — deployment runbook template available: /deploys/routing-change
  ```
  route_rule {
    match: "customer_id == \"zenith\""
    action: "model:embed-lite, weight:100"
    rollout: "canary:10%,10m; 30%,15m; 100%"
  }
  ```

eng-lead: If embed-lite keeps latency in SLO, I can authorize short-term capacity bump for 2 hours. Need expected QPS and quality hit estimate.

samir: Expected QPS for Zenith peak ~120 rps. Embed-lite should handle it but quality delta ~2-3% on their eval set (low-risk for their use case per CS notes).

toni: I'll own the canary and the monitoring checks. Plan: dark canary for 10m, then 10/30/60 rollout. If p99 stays < target and errors < baseline+10%, continue. Else immediate rollback.

oncall-rot: Oncall will set temp alerts for embeddings p99 > 1.5x baseline and error rate > +5% and post to #incidents. I'll be the pager during the rollout.

maria-ps: I'll tell the CSM: "We have a 45m plan to route you to a smaller embedding model as a temporary mitigation; quality impact is expected to be minimal, and we will monitor closely. We'll update within 15m with confirmation." Sending now. :email:

lauren: Owners + commitments: samir=implement routing (45m), toni=canary + rollout checks, eng-lead=infra sign-off, oncall-rot=monitoring, maria-ps=customer comms. Please react with ack.

samir: ack — starting prep now.

toni: ack. will coordinate with samir for canary timing.

eng-lead: ack from infra. allocate temporary capacity, please keep footprint minimal.

oncall-rot: ack and will watch alerts.

maria-ps: CSM confirmed they sent Zenith the ETA. Will update after the canary.

lauren: Thanks team. After we stabilize, we should follow up with a short postmortem listing root cause (kv eviction vs variant mismatch), long-term fix (cache sizing or smarter routing), and a customer-facing summary. :thumbsup:
